2026-08-02.patch_summary: This patch adds a new selftest called khugepaged_race to the Linux kernel's testing framework. The test is designed to exercise the khugepaged collapse driver under contention by introducing multiple threads that race against each other to collapse huge pages. The test includes three different scenarios: stepped, free-running, and madvise-driven collapse. The test also checks for correct behavior of the kernel-side assertions and uses a combination of faulters, fork children, and mremap threads to simulate real-world usage patterns.
